normalization: ASCII only; split punctuation; split lowercase/digit before uppercase and acronym before UpperLower; retain digit runs with words; lowercase; no transliteration
emission: Each token emits namespace:w:token and namespace:cN:substring for every byte ngram of lengths 2..5. Duplicate feature occurrences sum. Tokens never cross words. Column, table, neighbor, type use the same grammar. key_role:w:{primary_key,foreign_key,unique_constraint} emits only for true flags. Each table/column word pair emits table_column_interaction:w:tableword/columnword. No row-value, comment or default tokens.
hash: FNV-1a uint64 UTF-8; offset 14695981039346656037; prime 1099511628211; bucket low 14 bits; sign from high bit; L2 normalize aggregated hashed block in float64 then cast FP32
overflow: Stop adding new unique feature names at 2048; mark feature_overflow; require review
profiling: ProfileSamples accepts at most 64 already-returned UTF-8 values of at most 256 bytes. It exports numeric aggregates only. Truncated values contribute lengths but not complete-value distinct/format fractions. Nearest-rank p95 includes all non-null returned lengths. Numeric regex, ASCII email, formatted 7..15-digit phone, UUID, unzoned IP, http/https/ftp URL without userinfo, ISO date, 13..19-digit Luhn with nonzero digits, explicit secret prefixes, Shannon entropy >=4 bits/byte at length>=20, complete JSON container and multiline recognizers are pinned by embedded profiler source and golden fixtures. No PostgreSQL sampler is included.
